En tant qu’artiste d’effets spéciaux à Ubisoft Montréal, vous concevrez, intégrerez et optimiserez des effets en temps réel pour un jeu compétitif d’arène de bataille multijoueur en ligne (MOBA). Votre travail portera principalement sur les effets liés au champ de bataille et à la jouabilité. Ces effets aideront les personnes qui jouent à comprendre rapidement les actions, les menaces, les résultats et les priorités pendant les combats.
 Vous combinerez votre jugement artistique et votre expertise technique d’Unreal Engine pour créer des effets expressifs, lisibles et performants, dans le respect de la direction artistique. Vous collaborerez avec les équipes de conception de jeu, de programmation, d’animation, de réalisation et d’art pour soutenir l’identité visuelle du jeu et la clarté de l’expérience.
 Ce que vous ferez 
 Créer et intégrer des effets spéciaux en temps réel dans Unreal Engine , à l’aide de Niagara, des matériaux, des instances de matériaux, des nuanceurs, des textures, des maillages et des Blueprints, selon les besoins
 Concevoir des effets qui communiquent clairement les capacités, attaques, impacts, zones d’effet, changements de statut, objectifs et dangers , ainsi que les autres états de jeu
 Assurer la lisibilité de la jouabilité, la hiérarchie visuelle, la synchronisation, l’anticipation et l’impact des effets pour faciliter la prise de décision, sans surcharger les combats à grande échelle ni les capacités qui se chevauchent
 Collaborer avec l’équipe de conception de jeu pour traduire les intentions et les mécaniques de jeu en retours visuels clairs
 Collaborer avec les équipes de programmation et d’art technique pour évaluer les besoins techniques, améliorer les chaînes de production, résoudre les problèmes d’intégration et soutenir le développement des outils d’effets spéciaux
 Travailler avec les équipes d’ animation, de réalisation, d’art des personnages, d’art des environnements, d’interface utilisateur et d’audio pour créer des retours cohérents pour les personnes qui jouent
 Intégrer, déboguer, mesurer les performances et optimiser les effets pour respecter les contraintes de performance en temps réel, de mémoire, d’adaptation aux capacités matérielles et des différentes plateformes 
 Améliorer les effets selon les séances de test de jeu , les données de télémétrie disponibles, la direction artistique, les priorités de production et les commentaires des équipes multidisciplinaires
 Maintenir la qualité et la cohérence des effets grâce à la documentation, aux conventions de nomenclature, aux systèmes réutilisables et aux normes de production établies
 Participer aux revues pour repérer les risques liés au périmètre de production, à la lisibilité, à la performance, aux dépendances et au travail à reprendre
Ce que vous apportez à l'équipe 
 Une expérience professionnelle pertinente en effets spéciaux temps réel , en développement de jeux ou dans une discipline connexe, ainsi qu’une excellente maîtrise d’Unreal Engine en production et de la création d’effets liés à la jouabilité
 Une expérience pratique de Niagara, des nuanceurs, des textures, des maillages et des chaînes de rendu en temps réel , ainsi qu’une compréhension des outils et chaînes de production en deux et trois dimensions utilisés pour créer les ressources nécessaires aux effets
 Une compréhension approfondie de la lisibilité de la jouabilité, des retours visuels, de la synchronisation, de l’anticipation et de la hiérarchie visuelle , ainsi que des fondamentaux artistiques : composition, couleur, éclairage, mouvement, langage des formes, proportions et contraste
 Une capacité à créer des effets expressifs dans les limites de temps de rendu par image, de mémoire, de rendus superposés des mêmes pixels, de transparence et d’adaptation aux capacités matérielles , et à diagnostiquer les problèmes de ressources, de matériaux, de particules, de Blueprints, d’intégration et de comportement en temps réel
 Une capacité à accueillir les commentaires, à améliorer votre travail, à communiquer clairement et à collaborer avec plusieurs disciplines
 Un souci du détail, un sens de l’ organisation et de la prise en charge de votre travail , ainsi qu’une capacité à respecter les priorités et les échéanciers de production
 Des expériences souhaitables, mais non obligatoires , en création d’effets pour un MOBA, un jeu multijoueur compétitif, un jeu d’action ou un jeu où la lisibilité est essentielle; en développement de jeux en exploitation, en améliorations après lancement ou en optimisation pour différents matériels; ou en livraison ou en soutien d’un jeu développé avec Unreal Engine
 Des connaissances complémentaires appréciées, mais non obligatoires , notamment une maîtrise avancée de Niagara, des nuanceurs Unreal, de l’intégration Blueprint, de la mesure des performances et des paramètres d’adaptation des effets aux capacités matérielles; une connaissance de Photoshop, Maya, 3ds Max, Blender ou Substance 3D; ou une compréhension des mathématiques vectorielles appliquées aux mouvements et aux effets procéduraux
 Ce qu’il faut nous envoyer 
 Votre CV mettant en valeur vos compétences, votre expérience pertinente, vos responsabilités et votre expertise technique
 Un portfolio ou une démo de vos meilleures réalisations en effets spéciaux temps réel, présentant votre processus de création, les outils utilisés, votre contribution et les contraintes de jouabilité ou de performance rencontrées, sous forme de fichiers joints ou d’un lien vers votre site Web personnel ou votre portfolio en ligne

About Liferaft 
 Liferaft builds software that helps organizations find, understand, and act on potential risks from publicly available information. Our clients include corporate security teams around the world, including some of the world’s leading organizations. We’re a remote-first company committed to building a high-performing, values-driven team that operates with clarity, discipline, accountability, and care.
 Liferaft was recently acquired by global security company Securitas, expanding our ability to deliver intelligence-led security at scale. Together, our technology and security solutions help these organizations protect their people, assets, and operations, making a meaningful impact in the world we live in.
 About the Role 
 Liferaft is looking for a highly skilled and visionary Senior Software Engineer to play a critical role in building on the already sophisticated open source data collection capabilities we have. This role will be hybrid in Halifax, NS, or fully remote within Canada and must sit in either the Eastern, or Atlantic time zones.  
 As a Senior Software Engineer at Liferaft, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and enhancing the features that power our threat intelligence platform. Working across both front-end and back-end technologies, you will help deliver intuitive, high-performing user experiences supported by reliable and scalable services.
 You will work primarily with React, Python, and PHP, contributing to both modern UI development and backend functionality. You will collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, UX, and Labs teams to build innovative solutions, integrate AI-powered capabilities, and continuously improve our platform. 
What you do as a Senior Software Engineer at Liferaft 
 Design, develop, and maintain modern, responsive, and intuitive user interfaces using React, with a strong focus on usability, performance, and maintainability.
 Build and enhance backend services using Python and PHP, developing APIs and business logic that support seamless integration between front-end components and backend systems.
 Contribute to the evolution of our platform's architecture, modernizing existing components, improving code quality, and ensuring scalability and long-term maintainability.
 Collaborate closely with Product, UX, and Engineering teams to translate business requirements and design concepts into well-structured, reliable, and user-friendly features.
 Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity, accelerate development, strengthen testing practices, and explore new approaches to solving technical challenges.
 Participate in technical design discussions, code reviews, and architectural decisions, contributing to engineering best practices and maintaining high standards for code quality, security, and performance.
 Stay curious and continuously learn, exploring emerging technologies, modern development practices, and opportunities to improve how we build and deliver software.
 Collaborate with engineering leadership to help shape the technical direction of the OSINT platform in alignment with Liferaft’s mission and customer needs. 
 5+ years of professional software development experience, with a strong background in full-stack application development.
 Strong hands-on experience with React, JavaScript, and TypeScript, building modern, responsive, and maintainable user interfaces.
 Solid backend development experience with Python, PHP, or similar server-side programming languages.
 Experience designing, developing, and integrating RESTful APIs, including working with JSON, HTTP protocols, authentication, and third-party service integrations.
 Strong knowledge of SQL and relational databases,  including writing efficient queries, data modeling, and database optimization.
 Experience working with AI-powered development tools and coding agents, such as Claude Code, or similar technologies, to improve development efficiency, code quality, and testing.
 Familiarity with AI agents, and modern AI integration patterns, with an interest in building intelligent, AI-enabled product features.
 Experience with modern software development practices, including  automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, code reviews, and Agile methodologies.
 Good understanding of software architecture, application performance, security, and maintainability, across both front-end and back-end systems.
Bonus Points 
 Familiarity with event-driven architectures and messaging technologies such as RabbitMQ or Kafka.
 Experience integrating LLM APIs, AI agents, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) into applications.
 Familiarity with cloud environments, containerization, and Docker.
 Experience with Elasticsearch or other search and indexing technologies.
 Experience working with large-scale SaaS platforms or data-intensive applications.
 Why Liferaft? 
 We pride ourselves on our innovative spirit and determination to help solve new challenges developed by the complexities of open source data. Liferaft provides a threat intelligence and investigations platform to corporate security teams around the world, including some of the biggest brands you've probably referenced today! Our platform is designed to identify, track, and validate issues from open source channels (surface, deep web, and darknet) related to executive safety, fraud prevention, and asset & infrastructure protection. Our technology is helping keep these companies, their people, and their operations safe, making a real impact in the world we all live in.
 The diversity of our team is integral to our success. We are a team of passionate and supportive individuals and pride ourselves in fostering a collaborative, innovative, and fun culture. 
We offer our team: 
 Competitive compensation plan 
 Flexible PTO – Our team is encouraged to take a minimum of 15 days/year with no cap beyond
 Hybrid workplace with flexible working hours
 Health & Dental Benefits (Medavie Blue Cross)
 80% employer paid benefits
 Orthodontic coverage for minor dependents 
 Comprehensive mental health coverage, up to $3,000 per year, available for employees and dependents
 Free access to EAP, Greenshield and a variety of physical and mental health services via wellness platform
 $750 Yearly Lifestyle Subsidy
 Monthly cell phone reimbursement
 Monthly parking reimbursement
 Company-sponsored social events and team-building activities
 Strong culture of employee recognition
 Monthly peer-nominated “Cheers” awards with gift card draws
 Quarterly Performance Awards recognizing exceptional impact, collaboration, and innovation
 Diversity, Equity & Inclusion Committee
 Authentic, engaged team, who value work life balance
Hiring Process: 
 We’re building a company future generations can be proud of. Diversity at Liferaft means fostering a workplace in which individual differences are recognized, appreciated, respected and responded to in ways that fully develop and utilize each person's talents and strengths. We welcome all qualified applicants regardless of race, national or ethnic origin, colour, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, family status, genetic characteristics, disability, or any other protected characteristic. 
 This posting is for an existing vacancy.

AI Avatar Supplements Copywriter
 Organic Instagram & Facebook Reels | Direct Response Copywriting
 About Us
 Impact Clients is a fast-growing, 100% bootstrapped online education and software company. Through courses, coaching, and software, we help everyday people develop practical skills and build digital product businesses.
 We are launching an exciting new business division focused on AI avatars, viral health and wellness content, and supplement affiliate marketing.
 We are hiring a full-time AI Avatar Supplements Copywriter to join our internal team and help us build a portfolio of highly successful Instagram and Facebook accounts that generate millions of organic views and drive supplement sales.
 Your primary mission is simple: Research viral content, write exceptional short-form scripts, and turn organic views into supplement affiliate revenue.
 This is a hands-on creative position for someone who understands how to capture attention, write compelling health and wellness content, and turn social media engagement into measurable revenue.
 Company: Impact Clients
Website: https://go.impactclients.co/ Language: English
Availability: Full-Time (40 hours/week)
Time Zone: ET business-hour overlap preferred
Work Type: Full-Time, Remote
Industry: Health & Wellness, Supplements, AI Avatars, Affiliate Marketing, Direct Response
Expected Compensation: 2,000 - 3,000 USD/month
 Our Business Model
 We are building a new portfolio of organic Instagram and Facebook accounts focused on health, wellness, longevity, and supplement-related topics.
 Rather than using traditional human influencers, we use AI-generated avatars to create engaging, educational, and entertaining short-form videos.
 Here's how the business works:
 Research Viral Content: Identify high-performing health and wellness videos, trending topics, proven hooks, and compelling educational angles.
 Write Scripts: Turn research into original, attention-grabbing Instagram and Facebook Reel scripts designed to maximize retention, engagement, and sharing.
 Create AI Avatar Videos: Our production team uses AI avatar technology and video editing to bring your scripts to life.
 Drive Organic Traffic: Publish content across our Instagram and Facebook accounts to generate views, followers, and product interest.
 Generate Affiliate Revenue: Direct interested viewers toward relevant supplements sold through affiliate partners, including Amazon product pages, where purchases can generate commissions.
 Our goal is to build a repeatable, scalable content engine that consistently produces viral videos and generates meaningful affiliate revenue.
 You will be responsible for the research, hooks, storytelling, and scripts that power this entire operation.
 Example Accounts & Creative References
 Below are examples of Instagram accounts operating in the type of health and wellness content space we are entering.
 Please review these accounts before applying to understand the general content formats, topics, and creative styles we are looking to develop:
 Nutrition Is Greatness: https://www.instagram.com/nutrition.is.greatness/reels/ 
 Wellness Everyday Health: https://www.instagram.com/wellnesseverydayhealth/reels/ 
 Homestead Wellness Daily: https://www.instagram.com/homestead.wellness.daily/reels/ 
 Tyler Wellness Daily: https://www.instagram.com/tylerwellnessdaily/reels/ 
 Health Is Greatness: https://www.instagram.com/health.is.greatness/reels/ 
 Travis on Wellness: https://www.instagram.com/travisonwellness/reels/ 
 These accounts are provided as creative references for the type of organic health and wellness content we intend to produce.
 Your responsibility will be to research what makes content successful in this market and develop original scripts that can achieve comparable or better results.
 We are looking for someone who can identify proven viral patterns and turn them into original, engaging, revenue-generating content—not simply copy or rewrite another creator's videos.
 Responsibilities
 Research viral content daily: Discover high-performing Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, and other short-form videos in the health, wellness, longevity, and supplement markets.
 Write high-converting scripts: Develop original short-form video scripts designed to generate strong hooks, watch time, engagement, shares, and supplement affiliate sales.
 Develop compelling hooks: Write attention-grabbing openings that stop viewers from scrolling and make them want to watch the entire video.
 Master short-form storytelling: Structure scripts with compelling introductions, curiosity, educational value, and natural transitions into product-related calls to action.
 Research supplement products: Understand the supplements we promote, their ingredients, intended uses, consumer interests, and approved product positioning.
 Write product-focused content: Develop educational and promotional content around health topics that naturally connects to relevant supplement products.
 Optimize for revenue: Understand that our goal is not simply generating millions of views, but producing content that translates into clicks, qualified product interest, and affiliate commissions.
 Collaborate with AI video editors: Work closely with our AI avatar production team to ensure scripts translate into compelling final videos.
 Analyze performance: Review metrics including views, average watch time, engagement, clicks, and attributable sales to identify successful formats and improve future scripts.
 Build repeatable content systems: Organize research, winning hooks, proven angles, and creative templates to help our team consistently produce high-performing content at scale.
 Maintain compliance: Ensure health and supplement scripts avoid unsubstantiated medical claims, misleading representations, and prohibited claims while following applicable FTC guidance, affiliate disclosure rules, and platform policies.
 Continuously improve: Test different hooks, messaging angles, storytelling structures, and calls to action based on performance feedback.
 Must-Haves
 Strong copywriting ability, particularly for short-form videos, direct-response marketing, or social media content.
 Demonstrated ability to research viral content and understand why certain videos outperform others.
 Excellent understanding of Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, and short-form content retention.
 Ability to write engaging scripts that communicate complex topics in simple, compelling language.
 Strong research skills and an ability to identify interesting health and wellness topics from credible sources.
 Understanding of persuasive writing, consumer psychology, curiosity-driven hooks, and effective calls to action.
 Ability to produce scripts consistently at high volume without sacrificing quality.
 Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate research, ideation, and writing while maintaining originality and accuracy.
 Willingness to learn about supplements, affiliate marketing, and direct-response content monetization.
 Strong attention to detail, ability to follow feedback, and willingness to iterate based on performance.
 Excellent written English and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced remote environment.
 Nice To Haves
 Experience writing viral Instagram or Facebook Reels that have generated 1M+ views.
 Experience writing direct-response copy specifically for supplements, health, wellness, nutrition, or longevity products.
 Proven track record writing social content that has generated measurable clicks, conversions, or affiliate revenue.
 Familiarity with AI avatar platforms, AI video generation, or faceless content production.
 Experience with supplement affiliate programs, Amazon Associates, or similar performance-based marketing models.
 Understanding of Facebook and Instagram algorithms, retention metrics, and organic content distribution.
 Experience writing comment-to-DM calls to action or using ManyChat-style automation workflows.
 Familiarity with supplement advertising compliance, health-related advertising restrictions, and affiliate disclosure standards.
 Experience creating high volumes of original content across multiple social media accounts.
 What Success Looks Like
 We are not hiring someone to simply write scripts and check boxes.
 We are hiring someone who is excited about the challenge of building a brand-new revenue division through viral content.
 Success in this position means:
 Consistently identifying promising viral content opportunities before they become oversaturated.
 Producing original scripts that achieve strong watch time, engagement, and organic reach.
 Developing repeatable winning formats that can be replicated across multiple accounts.
 Collaborating effectively with our AI avatar production team to maintain a consistent content pipeline.
 Creating content that generates meaningful affiliate clicks, supplement purchases, and attributable revenue.
 Continuously improving creative performance through research, testing, and iteration.
 Ultimately, we want a copywriter who thinks like both a creative strategist and a direct-response marketer.
 You should care just as much about whether a video generates sales as you do about whether it generates views.
 Our Core Values
 We believe that an exceptional company is built by exceptional people.
 Impact Clients has grown from zero to multiple eight figures without outside funding because our team operates with an entrepreneurial mindset, high standards, and a shared commitment to our customers.
 Our three core values define how we work:
 1. Client Success = Company Success
 Everything we do, from marketing and sales to coaching and fulfillment, exists to create the best possible outcomes for our customers.
 Client success always comes first.
 2. 1% Better Every Day
 We believe in constantly improving, both personally and professionally.
 Whether that's working out, reading, learning new skills, or sharing valuable ideas, our team takes personal growth seriously.
 We encourage continuous development—physically, mentally, and spiritually—and regularly share books, podcasts, lessons, and reflections with each other.
 3. FIO — Figure It Out
 We are an entrepreneurial, resourceful team of owners.
 We believe in hiring people who can take initiative, solve problems independently, and operate with very little micromanagement.
 Every team member is encouraged to treat their division like their own business, take full ownership of results, and find creative solutions to challenges.
 We believe that if you want to go fast, you go alone; if you want to go far, you go together. That's why we all choose as individuals to grow with this team because we are committed to the vision of building a billion-dollar enterprise-value organization, and having a ton of fun along the way.
 We work hard, set high standards, and genuinely enjoy building alongside talented, ambitious people.
 Benefits & Opportunity
 Competitive compensation: 2,000–3,000 USD per month, depending on experience and qualifications.
 Build a new division: Join at the ground floor of an exciting new AI avatar and supplement affiliate marketing business.
 Creative autonomy: Research viral content, test fresh angles, and develop your own creative approaches to generating organic growth.
 High-growth environment: Work inside an established, multiple-eight-figure company launching a new revenue channel.
 Work with AI technology: Collaborate with a team using AI avatars, video generation, and modern content production tools.
 Growth opportunities: Potential to expand into senior copywriting, creative strategy, or content leadership responsibilities as the division grows.
 Fully remote: Work remotely with a results-oriented team that values autonomy, ownership, and execution.
 Entrepreneurial culture: Join a team of ambitious people committed to personal growth, excellence, and building something meaningful together.
 How To Apply
 If you're passionate about viral content, direct-response copywriting, AI technology, and health and wellness, we'd love to hear from you.
 Please be prepared to share examples of your previous copywriting work, particularly short-form video scripts, along with any available performance metrics demonstrating results.
 We are looking for someone who wants to do more than write content.
 We want someone who can help us build a viral content engine that consistently generates millions of views and turns that attention into real, measurable revenue.
 Apply below to join our team.

When the Tarr Steps, a footbridge assembled of heavy stones in Exmoor National Park in England, washed away in a flood in 1942, the Royal Engineers rebuilt it. Then it washed away again in 1952. So the Royal Engineers heaved in more stones: on and on, like a Sisyphean lesson in absurdity.
 Of course, they do this because the Tarr Steps are a historical monument, believed to be built during the Bronze Age. Modern bridge building looks a lot different and generally requires less upkeep. While we appreciate the charm of ancient things, Mercury is engineering the future of banking*. "Quaint" and "archaic" are not values we seek in our systems. Rebooting a tumbling server and hoping a flood of requests doesn't wash it away can be an emergency tactic, but we actively seek out durable solutions over monotonous ops work. You'll bring this ethos and teach others how to live it too.
 Up to this point, the Stability team at Mercury has primarily built platform-level constructs that product teams adopt. However, those teams are asking for us to work more closely with them to mature their implementations and practices. We are creating an SRE team that will rotate through product teams. You will understand the team's domain, identify opportunities for improvements in reliability/observability/performance/preparedness and create self-reinforcing, virtuous cycles.
 As part of this role, you will:
 Embed with product teams, helping them improve their operational maturity by setting up and refining practices around on-call, monitoring, alerting, and run books
 Run regular game day exercises with product teams, helping them feel more prepared to investigate and quickly remediate incidents
 Jump into application code written in Haskell & TypeScript and implement reliability techniques such as retries, better error handling, better logging, circuit breaking, etc
 Steer SLOs towards meaningful customer outcomes that product teams are accountable for. Those SLOs become a strong signal for whether the product is working as intended
 Champion reliability practices through design document and code reviews
 Identify observability gaps that hinder debugging, incident response, and business intelligence and help close those
 Advocate for longer-term improvements that non-product engineering teams can drive
 Participate in the product team's on-call rotation while embedding or as part of a more general engineering rotation, helping us improve processes and how we learn from incidents
 The ideal candidate for the role:
 Has past Site Reliability Engineering or DevOps experience
 Has measurable examples of influencing an organization towards greater reliability
 Has significant experience with PostgreSQL
 Has authored and operated Temporal workflows

The Role
 Treewalk is an innovative and entrepreneurial mid-size accounting firm headquartered out of Vancouver with an expanding office presence across the country. We are a CPABC pre-approved training office that supports CPA students through their journey to designating. That being said, you don’t have to be in the program to join us – we are open to working with you to shape the career path that works for you. If you want to work with a great team of accounting professionals, you’ve found the right place.
 We are looking for a payroll specialist whose primary responsibility will be administering payroll for multiple clients in the US and Canada. This individual will maintain client salary databases and due to the nature of the position, should have a strong knowledge of Canadian payroll related laws and regulations. The successful candidate will report directly to the Accounting Manager and also work closely with other accounting professionals on our teams.
 What will your days look like 
 Preparation and processing of accurate and timely payrolls in compliance with the employment agreements and Canadian Revenue Agency (CRA) guidelines
 Maintains the integrity of the payroll database, ensuring compliance with established procedures and internal controls
 Preparation of timely and accurate year end reporting (T4A’s, T4’s etc)
 Resolves employee and system issues and interfaces with Human Resources on all payroll related issues
 Prepares accurate recording of payroll, expenses and allocations in accounting system
 Responsible for the accurate and timely reconciliation and reporting of payroll related government remittances
 Responsible for maintaining the good standing of government accounts throughout the year
 Continuously monitor changes to federal and provincial legislation impacting payroll and advise management when action is required
 Ensure compliance with legislation and organizational policies and procedures.
 Other ad-hoc duties including employment contract creation and any other projects as required
 Preparation of month, quarter and year end payroll reconciliations, working papers, analysis and reporting
 Onboarding new clients to the payroll system and recommending best practices
 Basic bookkeeping tasks for various clients
 Our ideal candidate... 
 At least 2 years of payroll experience; additional bookkeeping experience will be considered an asset
 A payroll certification is an asset (PCP)
 Experience processing payroll for employees in a non-unionized environment; both salaried and hourly
 Experience working with one or more payroll and electronic timekeeping software packages such as QuickBooks Time, ADP and Ceridian
 Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Excel;
 Proficient at working in a digital and paper-free environment.
 It’s Treewalk for a Reason 
 We’re flexible – we treat our team members like professionals and give them autonomy to exercise their judgment and manage their schedules as they see fit. Get that workout in, run those errands – we trust you to manage your workload and meet those deadlines.
 We keep it fun! We encourage social activities outside of work, have company initiatives to keep you engaged with your peers, and have great technological tools to keep you connected.
 We’ve got you covered from Day 1 - your extended healthcare and maternity leave benefits kick in on your first day of work!
 Who We Are
 Treewalk is an advisory practice based out of downtown Vancouver specializing in financial reporting and corporate services for public companies. We offer clients a complete service package to assist them in timely and accurate disclosures. Our clients are from all industry sectors and are issuers on the TSX-V, CSE, NASDAQ, and the OTC.
 We are one of the fastest growing accounting firms in Canada, and we’ve got some big goals that are going to send us to the top. We are a firm with an anti-firm culture - think tech start-up, but accounting. We’re ditching the traditional top-down management hierarchy approach and are leaning into a holacratic system of organizational governance. We are on a journey to become the go-to training place for accountants of all levels who want to work in industry. Our accounting practice specializes in assisting public companies with their financial reporting and accounting needs, and we help private companies navigate the waters of going and staying public. When it comes to clients, we are industry-agnostic. We never shy away from clients in new and emergent industries, and we’ve worked with companies in e-commerce, retail, manufacturing, cannabis, mining, and biotechnology, to name a few. We’ve got a lot on the go, and as far as we’re concerned, the only barrier to reaching our goals is finding exceptional talent to keep building out our team.
 Our Core Values
 Mastery:  At Treewalk, we pursue knowledge. We aspire to be the best at our craft, and we create and pursue opportunities to build on our expertise.
 Support:  At Treewalk, you're never alone. Teamwork and collaboration are our bedrock, and constant support for each other and our clients is what sets us apart.
 Ownership:  At Treewalk, we fight to take responsibility. We own our mistakes and our oversights, and are relentlessly committed to our responsibility to our colleagues and our clients.
 Kaizen:  At Treewalk, we don't settle. Kaizen is a business philosophy that means "change for the better", or "continuous improvement". We recognize that nothing is perfect, but we're striving for it anyway.
 Annual Salary  - $65,000

Reporting to a Senior Manager, Hardware Engineering, you will work alongside experienced hardware, optical, firmware, reliability, manufacturing, and test engineers responsible for designing, ramping, and sustaining Ciena’s flagship WaveLogic™ optical modems. These products enable data rates of up to 1,600 Gbps and are used by many of the world’s largest telecommunications companies and cloud providers. In this role, you will help improve product yield, support manufacturing ramp, investigate technical issues, and drive hardware, test, or process changes that improve product quality and manufacturability. 
 This role provides a unique opportunity to develop a deep understanding of WaveLogic optical modems, from product design through manufacturing ramp and volume production. You will gain insight into the processes required to build a high-performance, high-volume product, while making contributions that directly support Ciena’s ability to deliver to customers and grow this flagship product line. 
 How You Will Contribute:  
 In this intermediate engineering role, you will support product ramp and sustaining activities, with a focus on yield improvement through test, design, and process improvements. You will combine manufacturing data analysis with hands-on lab debug and cross-functional execution to identify issues, recommend corrective actions, and help drive them to closure. 
 Hands-on lab debug: Perform hardware and optical debug of failed modules to identify root cause, validate hypotheses, and define corrective actions using lab measurements and engineering analysis. 
 Yield data analysis: Review large-scale manufacturing and test data to assess design, process, or test changes that improve factory yield.  Analyze trends, outliers, and common failure modes, then work with cross-functional teams to define practical corrective actions. 
 Change management: Plan, coordinate, validate, and release design, test, or process change orders that support yield improvement, ramp readiness, product quality, and manufacturability. 
 Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with hardware, optical, firmware, test, reliability, manufacturing, operations, and supplier-facing teams to drive technical issues to closure. 
 Documentation and communication: Summarize data analysis, debug findings, recommendations, validation results, and change plans clearly for technical and program stakeholders. 
 The Must Haves:  
 Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, Engineering Physics, or equivalent. 
 2–5 years of experience in hardware engineering, electrical engineering, optical hardware, telecommunications equipment, networking platforms, manufacturing test, or another complex electronic-product environment. 
 Familiarity with product lifecycle stages, including development, qualification, ramp, volume manufacturing, sustaining, field support, or end-of-life. 
 Demonstrated proficiency with statistical analysis techniques such as histogram distributions, Q-Q plots, standard deviation, process capability, Cp, Cpk, or related metrics. 
 Experience using scripting or programming tools such as Python or MATLAB for data analysis, automation, or engineering debug. 
 Ability to work hands-on in a lab environment and interpret electrical, optical, manufacturing, or system-level test results. 
 Strong communication skills, with the ability to present technical findings, trade-offs, and recommendations to cross-functional engineering and program teams. 
 Assets:  
 Demonstrated interest in prototyping, embedded hardware, hardware bring-up, or lab-based debug projects. 
 Familiarity with coherent optical transceivers, optical modems, DSP-based systems, or high-speed communications hardware. 
 Familiarity with high-volume manufacturing, manufacturing test flows, factory yield analysis, or production data systems. 
 Experience with optical test equipment, electrical test equipment, automated test platforms, reliability qualification testing, failure analysis, or root-cause corrective action processes. 
 Salary Range: The annual salary range for this position is $79,300 - $126,700

The role : As we grow, expand into new products, and prepare for scale, the engineers building Maple's products need a foundation that lets them move fast, safely, and autonomously. We're looking for a Director, Platform Engineering to build that foundation — and lead the team behind it. That’s where you come in. 
In this role, you'll stand up a new team whose customer is every other engineer at Maple. You'll own the developer experience end to end: CI/CD, deployment automation, observability, AI-assisted development tooling, test infrastructure, and the developer-facing infrastructure layer. This is a chance to define a platform mandate from scratch, partner directly with the VP of Engineering and CTO, and shape how Maple's engineering team builds software as we scale. The work you do here will compound — every hour your team saves a product engineer is an hour that goes back into the patient and provider experience.
Your responsibilities : As the Director of Platform Engineering, you’ll: 
 Own the platform engineering team's mandate end-to-end: developer environment, CI/CD and deployment pipelines, test infrastructure and quality tooling, framework and dependency health, AI tooling for engineers, and the AI feature tooling stack
 Serve Maple's product engineering squads as your primary customer — publish a platform roadmap, run developer surveys, and make prioritization calls based on developer friction data
 Drive engineering metrics in partnership with the VP of Engineering — stand up the tooling to measure developer experience, define the quantitative baselines, and set the roadmap to move them
 Hire, coach, and grow a small team of engineers, and set the operating model, rituals, and career expectations for the team
 Partner across Engineering, Business Technology, Security, Data, and Product to lead change — from shifting the org from manual to continuous deployment, to raising the bar on quality, observability, and incident response
 Stay hands-on where it matters: architecture reviews, prototyping, and unblocking your direct reports — while making sure the platform team stays a thin, high-leverage layer rather than an over-engineered one
 Translate platform investment into business outcomes for non-technical executive leaders and connect the team's roadmap to Maple's growth priorities
What success looks like : In your first 90 days, you'll have published a clear operating model and quarterly roadmap, and launched a baseline developer experience survey with a live metrics dashboard. You'll have built the hiring plan paired with roles and responsibilities for any open positions, and shipped a first handful of quick wins for the Product Engineering squads.
 In the following 12–18 months, you'll have moved Maple to continuous deployment on both backend and frontend, established a framework upgrade cadence that keeps the stack healthy, and matured E2E test infrastructure that runs on every PR. You'll have formalized incident management and an on-call rotation, matured our agentic engineering tooling, and put an AI evaluation harness in place. DORA metrics will trend into the "elite" range, developer experience survey scores will be measurably up, and the PR cycle time and code review burden will be measurably down — with the data to prove it.
What you bring: 5+ years of people leadership experience in engineering, including 2+ years building or leading a platform or developer experience team
 Director-level operating experience — you've owned a multi-domain technical roadmap and worked as a peer to other Directors and senior cross-functional leaders
 A track record of treating platform as a product — publishing roadmaps to internal customers, running developer surveys, setting up DevEx metrics, and making priority calls based on developer friction data, with a "thin platform" bias and a servant leadership orientation
 Deep expertise in modern CI/CD and deployment pipelines (GitHub Actions or equivalent, feature flag systems, progressive delivery, automated quality gates), and cloud infrastructure fluency (AWS preferred) — enough to be a credible counterpart to Business Technology in technical conversations
 Strong grounding in observability, incident management, and quality engineering — Datadog, SLOs, on-call design, blameless postmortems, E2E test frameworks, and shift-left quality
 Hands-on familiarity with AI-assisted development tooling (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, agent infrastructure) — you've actually shipped or operated AI tooling for engineers, not just watched the space
 A strong change management track record — you've led org-wide engineering transitions before (for example, shifting an org from manual to continuous deployment), and know how to build the case, sequence the rollout, and land the change without stalling delivery
 Strong written communication and comfort with ambiguity — you're joining a team that doesn't yet exist, and you know how to write decision docs, RFCs, and roadmaps that travel well in a hybrid org
Our tech stack: Here's the stack we're building with today. Curiosity and a strong learning mindset matter more to us than hands-on experience with every tool below:
 Backend: Built on Laravel PHP framework, with multiple integration services, such as Langfuse
 Frontend: React Native Web for a unified codebase across web and mobile, Typescript and styled components; we also leverage Alpine, Livewire and Tailwind
 Databases: Multi-database architecture with MySQL 8 and Amazon DocumentDB, Redis for caching, and Typesense for search engine indexing
 Infrastructure & DevOps: Containerized, auto-scaling architecture built on top of AWS; Infrastructure-as-Code setup with Terraform and GitHub Actions 
 Testing & QA: We utilize a number of testing tools for unit, integration, end-to-end and accessibility testing, such as PHPUnit, Jest, WebDriverIO, and axe-core
 Other tools & services: Monitoring and observability with Datadog, project management done through Jira, and BugSnag for error/crash monitoring

 CIBC’s Capital Markets business is committed to being the premier client-focused Capital Markets group in Canada, offering a comprehensive suite of credit, capital markets, investment banking, merchant banking, and research products and services to government, institutional, corporate, and retail clients both domestically and internationally.
 As the Executive Director, Global Regulatory Change Management and Program Delivery, reporting to the Managing Director, you will be responsible for leading the Capital Markets Global Regulatory program and project delivery team. You will be accountable for overseeing a portfolio of planned and in-flight regulatory changes ensuring appropriate funding, resourcing and escalation of risks when required. You will also be accountable for leading a project delivery practice that includes both business and regulatory changes. You will manage and oversee the program financials for the Capital Markets Compliance programs, creating governance arrangements from the inception of new changes through the impact assessment and financial planning process. You will identify and engage key stakeholders across the enterprise to ensure alignment, collaboration and transparency. You will lead a project and program delivery practice accountable for delivery regulatory and business changes across Capital Markets. You will build out the consistent application of tools, frameworks and techniques for initiating, planning, organizing, monitoring and controlling projects with a focus on financial and schedule management and demonstrate creative problem-solving skills by thriving in ambiguity, connecting the dots and driving continuous improvement.
 At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (proportion of on-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview. 
 How you’ll succeed 
 Regulatory Program Financial Management – You will manage and oversee the program financials by adopting a comprehensive and holistic approach the encompasses all aspects of the program. You will establish adequate governance and controls around one-time expenditures and new ongoing costs, ensuring appropriate levels of transparency throughout the process. Additionally, you will implement strategies to control spending while collaborating with partners to allocate resources effectively, promoting financial responsibility and efficiency.

À propos de MaintainX

MaintainX est une plateforme d’exécution du travail de premier plan, conçue d’abord pour le mobile, à l’intention des équipes industrielles et de première ligne. Plus de 13 000 clients, dont Duracell, McDonald’s, Shell, DHL et Volvo, utilisent MaintainX pour réduire les arrêts imprévus et mieux gérer leurs opérations. La plateforme compte plus de 13,9 millions d’actifs gérés et 79,5 millions d’ordres de travail complétés, et nous bâtissons le plus vaste ensemble de données opérationnelles réelles de la catégorie.

En août 2026, MaintainX est devenue partie intégrante d’Autodesk et a rejoint Autodesk Operations Solutions, l’organisation qui unifie la plateforme d’exploitation d’Autodesk aux côtés de Tandem, FlexSim et Fusion Operations. La stratégie d’Autodesk consiste à réunir la conception, la fabrication et l’exploitation en un seul cycle de vie continu : concevoir un actif, le construire, l’exploiter, puis réinjecter ce que l’on apprend en l’exploitant dans la conception suivante. Autodesk avait la conception et la fabrication. L’exploitation est la phase qui révèle ce qui s’est réellement passé, et c’est la nôtre.

Contexte du poste

Ce poste fait partie de l’équipe Marketing de croissance client, au sein du programme de marketing par comptes ciblés (ABM) qui favorise l’expansion des sites chez nos clients existants des segments Grandes entreprises et Marché intermédiaire. Vous dirigerez les campagnes qui font connaître MaintainX à de nouveaux sites et à de nouveaux départements, afin que le pipeline d’expansion continue de croître à mesure que les cibles augmentent.

Le poste

Vous serez responsable de l’exécution de nos programmes ABM, afin que nous joignions un plus grand nombre de nos comptes ciblés avec des campagnes opportunes et pertinentes.

 - Piloter nos programmes ABM payants sur LinkedIn et en mode programmatique : constituer des audiences à partir de listes de comptes et de signaux, réallouer le budget et le contenu créatif selon l’engagement, et tester de nouveaux canaux à mesure que le budget augmente. Planifier et lancer des campagnes coordonnées (webinaires, événements, courriel, publipostage), synchronisées avec l’activité des comptes et les priorités des Ventes, afin que l’équipe des Ventes ait un point de contact pertinent lorsqu’un compte manifeste des signaux d’achat.

 - Configurer les campagnes dans nos outils ABM et de marketing, en contrôler la qualité, et maintenir des données de comptes et de contacts propres afin de joindre les bonnes personnes.

 - Rédiger les mandats pour les publicités et les pages d’atterrissage à l’intention de l’équipe de création, et tenir un calendrier de renouvellement pour qu’aucune campagne ne s’essouffle.

 - Produire des rapports sur les résultats des campagnes et proposer vos propres idées d’approches un-à-quelques et un-à-un, afin de cibler davantage de comptes à forte valeur.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec notre gestionnaire principal, ABM, qui définit la stratégie et la conception des signaux, et en partenariat avec les équipes des Ventes, du Succès client, des Événements et du Contenu. D’ici 6 à 12 mois, vous piloterez nos programmes payants de façon autonome, vous serez responsable de vos indicateurs de pipeline et vous aurez conçu vos propres approches par compte.

Votre profil

 - 4 ans et plus d’expérience en marketing B2B SaaS, avec une expérience concrète en publicité numérique payante, en ABM ou en génération de la demande

 - Expérience de gestion de campagnes payantes, idéalement sur LinkedIn et en mode programmatique, avec optimisation en fonction de la qualité du pipeline plutôt que du volume

 - Parcours démontré d’exécution de campagnes multicanaux de bout en bout, idéalement des campagnes ABM

 - Connaissance pratique d’Outreach (ou d’un outil semblable) et de Salesforce

 - Solides compétences en gestion de projet pour mener de front de nombreuses campagnes et échéances

 - Aisance à extraire des données de performance, à repérer des tendances et à en expliquer la signification

 - Esprit d’initiative et aisance avec l’ambiguïté : vous évoluez bien dans un environnement en forte croissance où les priorités changent

Atouts :

 - Expérience avec des outils d’ABM ou de veille commerciale (UserGems, ZoomInfo, Clay, Demandbase, 6sense)

 - Expérience du publipostage ou d’autres tactiques ABM hors ligne

 - Expérience dans le secteur des logiciels industriels ou d’exploitation

Ce que nous offrons

 - Un travail qui se voit dans le monde réel. Les comptes que vous ciblez exploitent des usines, des flottes et des installations, et quand notre logiciel fonctionne, leurs lignes de production restent en marche.

 - Un produit que l’industrie aime déjà. Les clients qui nous choisissent renouvellent et étendent leur déploiement : vous bâtissez sur quelque chose qui gagne déjà.

 - L’envergure d’Autodesk, la même mission. MaintainX fait partie d’Autodesk Operations Solutions (AOS), qui apporte la portée mondiale d’Autodesk au problème que nous cherchions déjà à résoudre.

 - Une place tôt dans l’aventure. Ce programme prend rapidement de l’ampleur, et les approches par compte que nous n’avons pas encore eu la capacité de mener, c’est à vous de les concevoir.

Pour en savoir plus sur les avantages sociaux, consultez benefits.autodesk.com http://benefits.autodesk.com.

Notre façon de travailler

Nous récompensons les résultats et nous promouvons rapidement les personnes qui livrent. Nous embauchons en fonction de ce que vous avez bâti, pas de votre titre. Vous bénéficiez de l’autonomie et de la confiance nécessaire pour l’exercer, et nous attendons de vous que vous proposiez des idées plutôt que d’attendre qu’on vous les demande. Les priorités changent dans une entreprise qui croît aussi vite, et nous le disons ouvertement.

MaintainX s’engage à créer un environnement de travail inclusif. Toutes les candidatures qualifiées seront considérées sans égard à la race, la couleur, la religion, le genre, l’identité ou l’expression de genre, l’orientation sexuelle, l’origine nationale, la génétique, le handicap, l’âge ou le statut d’ancien combattant.

 Aluminium sans carbone

Des efforts sont présentement déployés afin de perfectionner cette nouvelle façon révolutionnaire de produire de l’aluminium, qui élimine le dioxyde de carbone et toutes les autres émissions de gaz à effet de serre du procédé conventionnel d’électrolyse.
 Le procédé ELYSIS élimine l’utilisation d’anodes de carbone, en les remplaçant par des matériaux brevetés. En tant que premier procédé industriel qui émet de l’oxygène comme sous-produit, il a le potentiel de transformer toute l’industrie.
 En 2018, deux producteurs d’aluminium de calibre international, Alcoa et Rio Tinto, ont uni leurs forces afin de créer la coentreprise ELYSIS avec le gouvernement du Québec. Bénéficiant du soutien du gouvernement du Canada et la technologie progresse et elle est actuellement conçue pour être utilisée aussi bien dans des projets de construction que de modernisation d’alumineries. 
 ELYSIS a son siège social à Montréal, avec des centres de recherche et de développement à Alma et à Jonquière, au Québec (Canada), ainsi qu’à New Kensington, en Pennsylvanie (États-Unis) et en France.

À PROPOS DE POWER FACTORS 
 Power Factors est un fournisseur de logiciels et de solutions qui mène la nouvelle génération de l’énergie propre avec Unity, l’une des suites de gestion de l’énergie renouvelable (REMS) les plus complètes et les plus largement déployées sur le marché. Avec plus de 300 GW d’actifs éoliens, solaires et de stockage d’énergie gérés dans le monde, plus de 600 clients et 18 000 sites, Power Factors gère 25 % des données mondiales sur les énergies renouvelables.*
 Unity REMS de Power Factors couvre l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur de l’énergie, de la supervision et du contrôle à l’analyse des marchés. Cette suite d’applications ouvertes, fondées sur les données, permet aux acteurs des énergies renouvelables de collaborer, d’automatiser les flux de travail critiques et de prendre des décisions plus éclairées afin de maximiser le rendement de leurs actifs. Les acteurs du secteur bénéficient d’un accompagnement de bout en bout, avec des solutions pour le SCADA et le PPC, la supervision centralisée, la gestion de la performance, la gestion commerciale des actifs et la gestion des interventions sur le terrain.
 Grâce à sa vaste expertise métier, Power Factors propose à grande échelle des analyses issues de l’IA, afin que les entreprises puissent optimiser leurs actifs, libérer leur croissance et prendre de meilleures décisions alors que le monde accélère sa transition vers une énergie propre. Power Factors lutte contre le changement climatique par le code.
 * Hors Chine et Inde
 Aperçu du poste 
 Power Factors recherche un recruteur principal expérimenté qui agira comme partenaire stratégique en acquisition de talents auprès des dirigeants d’affaires en Amérique du Nord et sur les marchés internationaux. Ce poste s’adresse à un recruteur chevronné, en contact direct avec les unités d’affaires, capable de mener des recherches complexes, de conseiller les dirigeants sur la stratégie en matière de talents et de contribuer à doter l’organisation des compétences nécessaires pour concrétiser ses priorités de croissance.
 Au-delà de la dotation des postes, le recruteur principal développera une solide compréhension du modèle d’affaires, des produits, des clients, des priorités, de la structure organisationnelle et des besoins futurs en main-d’œuvre. Il fournira des conseils de confiance sur les conditions du marché des talents, la disponibilité des compétences, les capacités organisationnelles, la planification de la main-d’œuvre, la dynamique concurrentielle de l’embauche et les stratégies d’évaluation des candidats.
 La personne retenue possédera une vaste expérience de l’industrie dans les logiciels, le SaaS, les énergies renouvelables, les technologies de l’énergie, les technologies industrielles, l’ingénierie ou des secteurs connexes. L’expérience en recrutement international est essentielle, y compris la capacité de recruter dans plusieurs zones géographiques, de comprendre différents marchés de talents et de collaborer efficacement avec des parties prenantes à l’échelle mondiale.
 À titre de membre IC6 de l’équipe mondiale d’acquisition de talents, cette personne pourra offrir un accompagnement, du coaching et du mentorat au quotidien aux recruteurs juniors, tout en contribuant à des pratiques de recrutement évolutives, à l’amélioration des processus et à des flux de travail de recrutement soutenus par l’IA.
 Raison d’être du poste 
 • Agir comme responsable principal de l’acquisition de talents et conseiller de confiance auprès des dirigeants d’affaires.
 • Traduire les priorités d’affaires en stratégies concrètes de talents et d’embauche.
 • Diriger le recrutement complexe et international pour des fonctions et des marchés d’affaires essentiels.
 • Renforcer la qualité des embauches, la compétitivité sur le marché, la prise de décision des dirigeants et la capacité de la main-d’œuvre à long terme.
 • Encadrer et soutenir les recruteurs juniors qui se joignent à l’équipe mondiale d’acquisition de talents.
 Principales responsabilités
 1. Conseil stratégique en talents et partenariat d’affaires 
 • Développer une compréhension approfondie du modèle d’affaires, des produits, des clients, des marchés, de la stratégie de croissance et des priorités organisationnelles de l’entreprise.
 • Agir comme conseiller de confiance auprès des dirigeants en matière de stratégie de talents, de planification de la main-d’œuvre, de capacité organisationnelle et de décisions d’embauche critiques.
 • Consulter les dirigeants sur les compétences, les expériences et les capacités requises pour atteindre les objectifs d’affaires.
 • Conseiller les parties prenantes sur les conditions du marché des talents, l’activité d’embauche des concurrents, les attentes salariales, la disponibilité des talents et les risques d’embauche.
 • Remettre en question les hypothèses d’embauche lorsque c’est pertinent et influencer les décisions à l’aide de données, de veille du marché et d’expertise sectorielle.
 • Collaborer avec les dirigeants pour anticiper les besoins futurs en talents et établir des stratégies de recrutement proactives pour les postes critiques.
 • Fournir des perspectives sur les écarts de compétences critiques, les enjeux de relève, la disponibilité externe des talents et les risques liés à la main-d’œuvre.
 2. Recrutement complexe de bout en bout 
 • Diriger le recrutement de bout en bout pour des postes complexes, de haut niveau, spécialisés, techniques, commerciaux, corporatifs et de direction.
 • Tenir des rencontres de cadrage stratégiques afin de clarifier le contexte d’affaires, les profils de réussite, les capacités indispensables, les critères d’évaluation et le positionnement sur le marché.
 • Concevoir des stratégies de recherche pour les postes difficiles à pourvoir, les compétences de niche, les marchés de talents concurrentiels et les besoins d’embauche internationaux.
 • Gérer le sourcing, la sélection, la mobilisation des candidats, la coordination des entrevues, le soutien aux offres et les activités de conclusion avec les candidats.
 • Collaborer avec les gestionnaires d’embauche pour assurer des décisions de sélection structurées, équitables, cohérentes et fondées sur des faits.
 • Représenter l’entreprise de façon professionnelle sur le marché et assurer une expérience candidat de grande qualité.
 3. Recrutement international et marchés mondiaux de talents 
 • Diriger les activités de recrutement en Amérique du Nord, en Europe et sur d’autres marchés internationaux, selon les besoins.
 • Élaborer des stratégies de sourcing adaptées aux bassins de talents régionaux, aux conditions du marché, aux exigences linguistiques et à la complexité du poste.
 • Collaborer avec les RH, le service juridique, les Finances et les parties prenantes de l’entreprise pour soutenir la stratégie d’embauche internationale, les modèles d’emploi et les considérations d’entrée sur de nouveaux marchés.
 • Conseiller les dirigeants sur la disponibilité mondiale des talents, la stratégie d’implantation, la compétitivité du marché et les compromis pratiques entre les options d’embauche locales, régionales et mondiales.
 • Constituer et maintenir des bassins de talents internationaux pour les postes critiques et récurrents.
 4. Expertise sectorielle et veille du marché 
 • Apporter une solide connaissance du marché externe issue des secteurs de la technologie, du SaaS, des technologies de l’énergie, des énergies renouvelables, de l’ingénierie, des technologies industrielles ou d’industries connexes.
 • Fournir aux dirigeants une veille pertinente du marché sur la disponibilité des talents, les attentes de rémunération, le comportement des concurrents et la faisabilité de l’embauche.
 • Repérer les tendances émergentes en matière de talents, les pénuries de compétences critiques et les risques de marché pouvant nuire à l’exécution des affaires.
 • Utiliser les données et les perspectives pour recommander des ajustements à la stratégie de recherche, à la conception des postes, au positionnement de la rémunération et aux critères de sélection des candidats.
 5. Leadership, coaching et soutien à l’équipe 
 • Offrir de l’accompagnement, du mentorat et un soutien quotidien aux recruteurs juniors et aux coordonnateurs de recrutement.
 • Soutenir l’intégration des nouveaux membres de l’équipe d’acquisition de talents en partageant les guides de recrutement, les approches de sourcing, les pratiques de gestion des parties prenantes et les normes du système de suivi des candidatures (ATS).
 • Encadrer les recruteurs en matière de cadrage stratégique, de cartographie des talents, d’évaluation des candidats, d’harmonisation avec les gestionnaires d’embauche et de conversations de conseil sur le marché.
 • Favoriser la cohérence de l’expérience candidat, de la qualité du recrutement, des pratiques d’entrevue et de la communication avec les parties prenantes au sein de l’équipe mondiale d’AT.
 • Agir comme point d’escalade principal pour les recherches complexes, les dynamiques difficiles avec les parties prenantes et les négociations délicates avec les candidats.
 6. Opérations de recrutement, amélioration des processus et intégration de l’IA 
 • Tenir à jour de façon exacte et en temps opportun les données de recrutement dans l’ATS et soutenir la production de rapports sur les principaux indicateurs de recrutement.
 • Repérer des occasions d’améliorer les processus de recrutement, de réduire l’effort administratif, de renforcer la qualité des embauches et d’améliorer l’expérience des gestionnaires d’embauche.
 • Contribuer à des guides de recrutement, des guides de sourcing, des cadres d’entrevue et des normes d’évaluation des candidats évolutifs.
 • Tirer parti de façon responsable des outils de recrutement fondés sur l’IA pour améliorer le sourcing, la prise de contact avec les candidats, la rédaction des descriptions de poste, les résumés de sélection et la productivité des recruteurs.
 • Soutenir l’utilisation responsable de l’IA en acquisition de talents en maintenant le jugement humain, l’équité et la sensibilisation aux biais au cœur des décisions d’embauche.
 Qualifications requises 
 • Plus de 10 ans d’expérience progressive en acquisition de talents, y compris la responsabilité de haut niveau de recherches complexes.
 • Expérience avérée comme conseiller stratégique en acquisition de talents auprès de dirigeants d’affaires, et non uniquement comme recruteur axé sur les demandes de dotation.
 • Solide expérience de l’industrie dans les logiciels, le SaaS, les énergies renouvelables, les technologies de l’énergie, les technologies industrielles, l’ingénierie ou des secteurs connexes.
 • Expérience significative du recrutement sur les marchés internationaux et du soutien à des équipes réparties à l’échelle mondiale.
 • Capacité avérée à conseiller les dirigeants sur la dynamique du marché des talents, la planification de la main-d’œuvre, la faisabilité de l’embauche et les besoins en capacité organisationnelle.
 • Solide expertise en sourcing direct, y compris la mobilisation de candidats passifs, la cartographie des talents, la veille concurrentielle et le développement de bassins de candidats.
 • Expérience du recrutement pour des postes techniques, commerciaux, corporatifs et de direction.
 • Capacité à influencer des parties prenantes de haut niveau, à remettre en question les hypothèses et à formuler des recommandations crédibles fondées sur le contexte d’affaires et la connaissance du marché.
 • Expérience de mentorat, de coaching ou d’accompagnement fonctionnel auprès de recruteurs juniors.
 • Solides compétences de communication écrite et orale, avec la capacité d’évoluer à l’aise dans un environnement mondial.
 Qualifications souhaitées 
 • Expérience au sein d’une entreprise mondiale de SaaS, de technologies de l’énergie, d’énergies renouvelables, de logiciels industriels ou d’une entreprise technologique à forte croissance.
 • Expérience du recrutement à Houston (Texas), à Boston (Massachusetts) ou sur d’autres marchés de talents concurrentiels en Amérique du Nord et à l’international.
 • Expérience avec Workable ou des systèmes de suivi des candidatures similaires.
 • Expérience de l’utilisation d’outils de sourcing, de recherche et de productivité en recrutement alimentés par l’IA.
 • Expérience du soutien à la planification de la main-d’œuvre, aux discussions sur la conception organisationnelle ou aux revues stratégiques des talents.
 • Expérience de la réduction de la dépendance aux agences grâce à la constitution proactive de bassins de candidats et au sourcing direct.

CapIntel is a software platform built for wealth management enterprises to help financial advisors explain complex investment strategies to their clients. Advisors at some of the biggest banks across North America are winning trust by using CapIntel to easily compare investments and create compelling, educational presentations. Ultimately, we're focused on investors getting better service, understanding their investments, and feeling at ease knowing their future is secure.

To support this momentum, we’re growing our team rapidly—investing in people who drive innovation at scale to expand our impact across the North American wealth management industry. 
 About the Role 
 CapIntel exists for the moments that shape someone's financial future. The conversation where an advisor explains a portfolio to a client anxious about retirement. The one where a family works out what happens to their parents' money now that their parents cannot manage it. Design is what makes those moments land, or fall flat. You are here to make them land.
 One proposal tool is becoming a multi-product platform. Your scope is a product area, and it outlives any single release. You are who the ambiguous problems get routed to, including the ones the team could not settle on its own. Nobody signs off on your approach before you take it. When the evidence points against product or engineering, you are expected to say so, and to be right often enough that they keep asking.
 And we build. Every designer ships something real every quarter: a prototype, a design system contribution, code. The best ideas here get built, not just drawn — you prototype until a direction is clear enough to commit to. Prototypes are how we scope work and settle arguments. AI is not a side experiment: reach for it by default and own what comes out. None of it happens alone: we review in the open, cover for each other, and the answer is usually a message away. People grow here by being handed something slightly bigger than the last one, and backed while they work it out.
 What you’ll do 
 Own an area: Carry a product area across releases, and own a piece of the system other designers depend on: components, a prototype the team scopes from, or tooling that makes everyone faster
 Prototype to decide: Build working prototypes with real components and data to test ideas and align product and engineering before anything is committed
 Decide what's worth knowing: Choose the research worth running and say no to the research that will not change a decision. Own the synthesis and the call that follows it
 Own the number: Set the measure before the build, then stay with it. When it does not move, say so early and change direction rather than defending the design
 Set the bar, not just meet it: Define what quality means in your area so others can hold it without you. Error and empty states, responsive, WCAG 2.0 AA , and the patterns that keep it consistent after you move on
 Make the hard call land: Take a contested recommendation to people who outrank you and get a decision. Bring the options you killed and what you would need to see to change your mind
 Grow the people around you: Raise the standard through review, mentoring and the work itself. Your area should be a place designers get better in
 What We’re Looking For

 Taking something from zero to one, not only iterating on what exists

Ceci est un rôle de haut niveau, centré sur la production, qui comporte son lot de responsabilités : vous créerez des effets utilisables en respectant la direction artistique, établirez le niveau de qualité à atteindre, accompagnerez d’autres artistes et vous assurerez que les effets visuels livrés sont cohérents au sein des équipes et sont conformes aux attentes des clients.

 Créer des effets visuels en temps réel sur mesure et les implémenter dans le moteur (UE5, Unity ou propriétaire).

BUILD SOMETHING PEOPLE LOVE

Wealthsimple is Canada’s leading financial innovator. The company offers a full suite of simple, sophisticated financial products across managed investing, do-it-yourself trading, cryptocurrency, tax filing, spending and saving. Wealthsimple currently serves more than 4 million Canadians and holds over $169 billion in assets under administration. The company was founded in 2014 by a team of financial experts and technology entrepreneurs, and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

About the role

This role turns people data into the decisions that shape how Wealthsimple hires, grows, and keeps its people. You will build the models, the analysis, and the data products that show how talent moves through Wealthsimple, where it concentrates, who is at risk of leaving, and what the workforce looks like a year out. Reporting to the Director, People Analytics, you will own that work end to end, from the question through to the thing people actually use. Success looks like recurring people decisions getting made from what you built.

About the team

People Analytics sits within People and Communications. We are growing the people domain and want to get deeper into our data, through the models, data products, and analysis that leaders across the company use to make calls about talent. We are a small team, building like a startup inside the People team. Analytics developers own the data foundation, analysts handle day-to-day reporting, and software engineers build the products that put insights in front of managers. As our first data scientist, you will help set what best in class looks like for people analytics at Wealthsimple.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the model building and the deeper analysis on people data, including attrition risk, workforce forecasting, and how talent moves and develops across the company.

 - Build people data products that leaders keep coming back to, working with our software engineers to put them in front of managers across Wealthsimple.

 - Move up and down the data stack as the question demands, from raw data through to the model and the surface it lands on.

 - Turn open questions from leaders and partners across the company into analysis they can act on, and be clear about what the data can and cannot support.

 - Bring statistical rigour to how we understand talent density and performance management, forming hypotheses and testing them so people decisions are data informed.

 - Set the analytical standard for the function and raise the level of craft around you, through how we test, document, and review our work.

SKILLS YOU BRING

 - 5+ years in data science or a related quantitative role, owning ambiguous problems end to end.

 - Advanced SQL and Python, applied to work you have taken all the way to production rather than left in a notebook.

 - Applied statistics and causal inference. You can pick a method, defend it, and explain why a correlation is not enough for the decision in front of you.

 - Experience building and evaluating predictive models on messy operational data, including the judgment to say when a model is not the right answer.

 - Experience turning analysis into recommendations that senior leaders act on, including pushing back when the question itself is wrong. You lead with the outcome, then explain how you got there.

 - Comfort working close to the data layer, with modelled datasets, point-in-time history, and a cloud data platform such as Snowflake.

NICE TO HAVE

 - HR data literacy: employee lifecycle events, job hierarchies, headcount types, and compensation structures.

 - Workforce planning or headcount forecasting.

 - Experience with survey and engagement data.

 - Experience measuring people performance, such as review ratings, calibration outcomes, or goal attainment.

People analytics experience helps, but it is not required. If you have done this kind of work in product, marketing, growth, or customer analytics and you are curious about people data, we want to hear from you.

WHO YOU ARE

 - You are energised by building, and you do not need a paved road to do good work.

 - You think about privacy the way a good engineer thinks about security, as a design constraint rather than an obstacle.

 - You would rather ship a useful answer and improve it than hold a perfect one back.

 - You are direct about uncertainty and say what you do not know before anyone asks.

 - You move between technical and non-technical conversations naturally.

 - You are pragmatic about AI tools and know where they speed you up and where they do not.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE THIS ROLE

 - Ground-floor impact: Most of this work hasn’t been done yet, so you’ll shape how it gets done.

 - Visibility: Your work goes in front of leadership and shapes real decisions about talent.

 - Builders around you: Your models ship into products managers use, not slide decks

WHY WEALTHSIMPLE?

🌸 Top-tier health benefits and life insurance

About Jetson 
 The Opportunity: 
 Most companies are adding AI to the software their teams already use. We're building it the other way around. 
 At Jetson, AI agents already do real operations work. They check rebate paperwork, plan the next steps on a project and draft replies to customers. People review that work, approve it and correct it, and every correction makes the agents better. 
 That changes the product question. It's no longer "what screen does this team need?" It's "which work should an agent do, which should a person do, and how do they hand it off?" 
 You'll own that answer for the people doing the work. Your customers are Jetson's own operations teams: rebates, project coordination, system design, customer success, billing, technical service and field operations. Each of them is moving onto one shared platform where people and agents work the same queue. You'll decide what each team sees, what the agents propose, what people approve, and how we know it's working. 
 The goal is aggressive: take a sale process that typically takes the industry 30+ days and make it three days from paying a deposit to installation. Every workflow you ship gets a home off fossil fuels sooner. 
 The best outcome is work nobody at Jetson has to do: an agent does it right, or the step disappears. 
 What You Will Do: 
 Bring operations teams onto the platform, one at a time. Sit with a team, map how their work really runs, decide what goes in their first release, and get it adopted. Rebates and project coordination come first. 
 Design how people and agents share the work. For each type of task, decide whether an agent suggests it, a person approves it, or it runs on its own. Define what "done" means and what proof shows it. 
 Graduate work to autonomy with evidence. Every new agent action starts as a suggestion. When people accept it nearly every time, it moves to one-click approval, then to fully automatic. You set the bar and track whether each action has earned the next step. 
 Turn corrections into data. When someone rejects or edits an agent's work, that's a labelled example. Build the eval sets that catch a regression before it ships. 
 Read the trace. When an agent gets something wrong, open the trace and find out why: bad data, a missing rule, the wrong tool or a weak prompt. Fix the cause, not the symptom. 
 What You Bring: 
 Experience: 5+ years as a product manager, shipping software people use every day. You care as much about how it feels to use as whether it works. 
 You've built with AI, not just used it. You've shipped something with a model inside it, even a side project, and you can tell us where it broke and what you did about it. You're comfortable in Claude Code or Cursor, SQL and Git. 
 You think in evals. "It works" isn't a claim until there's a set of real examples it passes. You'd rather show a precision number than a demo. 
 You know why it failed. You can tell a model limitation from bad data, a missing rule or a broken workflow. 
 You know when not to use an agent. A rule, a script or a better form is often cheaper and more reliable. You pick the simplest thing that works. 
 You go to the work. You'd rather sit next to a project coordinator for a morning than read a summary of what they do. 
 You write clearly. Your specs read like instructions an agent could follow, because sometimes they are. 
 You can say no. With 40 requests in the backlog, you can name the three that matter this week and explain why. 
 How We Build: 
 PMs ship code. Our product team builds with Claude Code and other AI tools every day: prototypes, internal tools, data pulls and fixes. Getting your hands dirty is the job, not a bonus. 
 You fix what you find. Spot a broken report or a clunky step? Build the fix yourself, then bring in engineering when it needs to scale. 
 We're always on the latest. The newest tools, models and ways of working, and we switch the moment something better ships. You'll have all of it, plus real data and engineers in the room when a prototype needs to become production software. 
 How We Hire: 
 Our process includes a 90-minute working session. You'll get a real (anonymized) operations workflow, the AI tools you'd use on the job, and one of us to work with. We want to see how you work, not how you interview. 
 Job Type: Full-time, Permanent 
 Pay: $125,000 to $158,000 per annum + Equity 
 Benefits: 
 Extended Health Care 
 Disability Insurance 
 Education Support 
 Parental Leave Top Up 
 Work Location: In person - Kitchener, ON
